A player with level 41 [[Smithing]] can forge the steel chainbody by using three [[steel bar]]s on an [[anvil]] with a [[hammer]] in their inventory, granting 112.5 [[Smithing]] [[experience]]. It can also be bought from [[Wayne's Chains]] in [[Falador]], or [[Horvik's Armour Shop]] in [[Varrock]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +17 |dslash = +25 |dcrush = +30 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +19 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Steel chainbody equipped male.png]] |altimage = [[File:Steel chainbody equipped female.png]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 41 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 112.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Steel bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Steel chainbody }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Steel chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Steel chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Steel chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Steel chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Steel chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Steel chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Steel chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Steel chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Steel chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Steel chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Steel chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
